steps: Browse the gig board and apply for shops
Complete the shop per client specs
PayPal credited twice monthly per the official staggered schedule (lag ~40-75 days)
timing: PayPal only, twice monthly: shops done 1st-15th paid ~25th-30th of next month; shops done 16th-31st paid ~10th-15th of the month after. Requires a PayPal account.
maximize: Start now, not when you need cash — the staggered cycle means your first payout lands 40-75 days after the shop. Only accept shops whose agreed amount beats your costs, and remember: real Confero never mails checks, PayPal only.
